title: The Ember Market Swindle
story: In the smoky Ember Market, Tesselock the Tally Ghoul sells firewood to the shivering widows of Ashfall and always "forgets" to give change. Mr 6 steps up with 40 ember coins to buy fuel for the whole street: bundles cost 3.5 ember coins each, plus a flat cart fee of 5 ember coins.
question: What is the greatest number of bundles Mr 6 can buy with his 40 ember coins?
solution: Take out the cart fee first: 40 - 5 = 35 ember coins left for bundles.
praise: Dividing by the bundle price was smart thinking — the flat cart fee just needed to come off the top first.
hint: One of those costs is paid only once, no matter how many bundles — pay it before you start dividing.
victory: Tesselock's crooked abacus clattered apart when Mr 6 read the price aloud, and the ghoul faded into the smoke muttering about honest customers. Ten bundles of fire warmed the whole street by dusk.
imagePrompt: A hunched ghoulish market vendor with a crooked abacus glaring at a small numeral-six knight who calmly counts ember coins, glowing firewood stacks and orange smoke filling a night market.
